focus_topics: Impossible Physics Micro-Stories: tangible physical experiments and paradoxes viewers can SEE immediately (non-Newtonian armor, acoustic waves crushing glass, magnetic eddy brakes, vortex cannon shockwaves, acoustic levitation)
Extreme material limits & optical/fluid wonders with vivid real-camera demonstrations
Shocking cosmic speed, gravity, and thermodynamics comparisons anchored to visible objects
avoid_angles: abstract invisible quantum jargon without dramatic physical visuals
neuroscience or psychology topics unrelated to physical demonstrations
lecture titles starting with 'The Physics of...'
repeating quantum levitation, superconductors, Prince Rupert's Drop, Mpemba hot-water freezing, gallium melting, liquid nitrogen sliding, or superfluid helium
physics.hook_style: Tell a 20-second Micro-Story about ONE visible object under extreme force: 'The [Concrete Object] That [Impossible Action]' or 'What Happens When [Force] Hits [Object]'
physics.extra_directive: Frame each Short as a fast-paced Micro-Story (Setup -> Escalation -> Mechanism -> Payoff) using strictly visible real-world physics—NEVER choose invisible forces or repeat classics.

focus_topics: Extreme Materials Micro-Stories: visible dramatic reactions, pyrophoric ignition, self-healing polymers, thermite, nitinol shape-memory, glowing luminol, hydrophobic surfaces
Bizarre element rivalries and extreme phase changes viewers can watch happen on camera
Hidden reactive chemistry inside everyday crystals, metals, and minerals
avoid_angles: repeating alkali metals (sodium/potassium) exploding in water
repeating gallium melting or eating aluminum, Prince Rupert's drop, instant plastic, or ferrofluid spikes
invisible gases or invisible clock reactions that look static/empty on camera
overused 'world's strongest acid' clichés
chemistry.hook_style: Spotlight one bizarre element or material in a Micro-Story arc: 'This [Material] [Shocking Visible Transformation]' or 'Why Chemists Fear [Specific Substance]'
chemistry.extra_directive: Build an addictive Extreme Elements Micro-Story series: never repeat past metals/liquids, and avoid invisible phenomena.

focus_topics: Wild Survival Micro-Stories: extreme deep-ocean predators, bizarre insect defense mechanisms, bioluminescent hunters, regeneration, fungal mind-control, and parasitic strategies
Shocking real-world animal engineering & botanical traps with unmistakable wildlife photography
Human-scale survival comparisons (e.g., louder than a jet engine, venom faster than a blink)
avoid_angles: human body organs, digestion, brain, throat, or medical anatomy (lower views and moderation risk)
repeating immortal jellyfish, mantis/pistol shrimp, bombardier beetle, wood frog freezing, iron-armored sea snail, parrotfish sand, or honeyguide bird
hyperbolic clickbait metaphors ('flies to the moon')
biology.hook_style: Open a wildlife survival Micro-Story: 'The Creature That [Bizarre Real Survival Tactic]' or 'How This Tiny [Animal/Plant] Defeats [Extreme Danger]'
biology.extra_directive: Pick ONE vivid organism with abundant real nature photos/footage and tell its survival Micro-Story from danger to twist to payoff.

focus_topics: Rule-Breakers Micro-Stories: bizarre proven anomalies (Cherenkov blue radiation in water, sonoluminescence star-in-a-jar, triboluminescence glowing tape, Oklo natural nuclear reactor)
Ancient planetary puzzles and counterintuitive engineering mysteries with vivid visual proof
avoid_angles: invisible air pressure or unseen gas concepts that look boring/empty on camera
dry textbook titles ending in 'Explained' or starting with 'Why Water...'
repeating supercooled water, gallium, Leidenfrost/ice on fire, ferrofluid, Prince Rupert's drop, or Mpemba effect
general_science.hook_style: Use Rule-Breakers Micro-Story titles: 'Earth Built [Impossible Thing] Naturally' or 'Can [Ordinary Object] Break [Famous Rule]?'
general_science.extra_directive: Turn every topic into a 20-second investigative Micro-Story about nature breaking its own rules—never like a school definition.

focus_topics: Hidden Planet Micro-Stories: blue lava craters, boiling rivers, magnetic reversals, deep brine lakes under the ocean, mega-lightning sprites above storms, underground crystal caves
Epic geological disasters, submarine volcanoes, permafrost secrets, and fossilized lightning (fulgurites)
Alien-looking landscapes right here on Earth
avoid_angles: dull textbook geography definitions or routine weather forecasts
repeating singing desert dunes, earth inner core stopping, underground crystal towers, or magma ocean diamonds
flat lowercase declarative titles
earth_science.hook_style: Use Hidden Planet Micro-Story titles: 'The River on Earth That Literally Boils' or 'Where Earth Turns Lightning Into Solid Glass'
earth_science.extra_directive: Tell a dramatic expedition-style Micro-Story set inside ONE unmistakable geological wonder with striking real landscape visuals.

focus_topics: Cosmic Extremes Micro-Stories: tidal disruption stars shredded by black holes, rogue worlds wandering starless space, pulsars, hypervelocity stars, kilonovae
Alien weather and extreme exoplanets (molten iron rain, pitch-black atmospheres, glass hurricanes)
Recent James Webb telescope cosmic mysteries and giant void structures
avoid_angles: vague 'staring back' eyeball-planet clichés
repeating Neptune diamond rain, white dwarf crystal diamond, or magnetar basic trivia
flat titles starting with 'It...'
astronomy.hook_style: Use Cosmic Extremes Micro-Story titles: 'The Planet Where It Rains Solid Iron' or 'The Dead Star That Spins 700 Times Per Second'
astronomy.extra_directive: Deliver awe-inspiring cosmic scale through a vivid Micro-Story following ONE star, moon, black hole, or exoplanet.
